summary: No snaps the index and middle fingers down onto the thumb, like a mouth closing, with a head shake. The head shake is part of the sign.
handshape: Index and middle fingers extended with thumb
movement: Two fingers snap closed against the thumb
steps: Extend the index and middle fingers together, with the thumb out.
Snap the two fingers down to meet the thumb, once or twice.
Shake your head as you do it.
note: You can negate a whole sentence in ASL with just a head shake and no NO sign at all. I LIKE COFFEE with a head shake means 'I don't like coffee.'
mistakes: Flat face and still head. The head shake carries the grammar.

faq.q: How is this different from NOT?
faq.a: NO is the reply word, like answering a question. NOT (a thumb flicking out from under the chin) negates a verb inside a sentence. Beginners can get by with NO plus a head shake.
